data.name: EigenGauge
data.detailed_description:
F-Zero's speed. Twisted Metal's combos. Floor it. This is hover racing at ridiculous velocity, tight and twitchy, where one clean line separates a record lap from a spectacular pile-up. But raw speed only gets you so far. Every ability is a combo: boosts, drifts, and specials all come from punching in face-button sequences on the fly, mid-corner, without lifting off the throttle. There's no partial credit... the chain holds or it resets to nothing.

But raw speed only gets you so far. Every ability is a combo. Boosts, drifts, and special maneuvers all come from punching in face-button sequences on the fly - and pulling them off mid-corner, without lifting off the throttle is the whole challenge. Nail the input and you rocket ahead. Fumble it and you're kissing a wall.

Handling is razor-sharp. These machines carve, drift, and cling to the track at speeds that should throw you off - master the controls and the inputs and you'll thread corners the pack can only dream about. Wall-rides, loop-the-loops, and tracks that curl in directions they shouldn't keep every lap on a knife's edge.

Every track is a love letter to the world's great roller coasters. The layouts borrow their DNA from legendary coasters - raven turns, pretzel loops, banana rolls, hangtime drops, and out-and-back twisters - reimagined at hover-racing speed. If you've ever wanted to drive a coaster instead of just ride it, this is that.

A good lap is nice. A stylish one scores more. Chain combos together cleanly to build your multiplier and climb the tier ranks - but flub a sequence or clip a wall and your streak's gone. The best runs are the ones where every input lands and you never lift off the throttle.

A roster of distinct drivers - from pure speed demons to nimble handlers to machines whose combo abilities flip the racing line on its head. Each vehicle brings two unique combos, three perks, and a garage of liveries that tune its stats to your style - so no two racers on the grid play the same. Everybody's got their own reason for showing up, too, whether they're an underdog with something to prove or a corporate hotshot who hates to lose.

Ten environments and dozens of tracks wind through nebulae, planet rings, and stations out at the cold edge of the system. Win races to unlock new tracks, new abilities, and whatever's hiding further down the tour.

Features

  • Combo-driven abilities: punch in face-button sequences to boost, drift, and unleash specials mid-race

  • Razor-sharp, high-speed handling in the spirit of the arcade racing greats

  • Tracks inspired by the world's most famous roller coasters - loops, corkscrews, and barrel rolls at full throttle

  • A multiplier system that rewards clean, chained inputs - win with style, not just speed

  • A variety of playable vehicles, each with its own abilities and combo sets and perks

  • 24 handmade tracks packed with wall-rides, loops, and gravity-defying sections

  • A whole star system of drivers, rivals, and secrets to dig up

  • Online multiplayer and local co-op

data.short_description: Race hover machines down tracks inspired by the world's craziest roller coasters - pretzel loops, raven turns, and all. Your abilities are combos: punch in face-button sequences at full throttle to boost and drift past the pack. Arcade racing speed with fighting-game inputs, at 1000kph.
